# K-Pick Trading Corp

> Manila-based company working with Korean medical device manufacturers,
> founded 2020. Exclusive Philippine distributor appointments for Sungshim
> and INSUFiNE. Tagline: Building Partnerships. Delivering Quality.
> Improving Lives.

This website is a company profile and product-information resource. It does
not take orders, publish prices, show stock, or accept payments, so no price,
availability or ordering process should be inferred or invented.

## Brand and product pages

- [Sungshim](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim.html): brand overview — syringes, needles and IV sets, exclusive Philippine distribution since 2024.
- [Insulin syringes](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim-insulin-syringe.html): 1 mL (100 units) and 0.5 mL (50 units), fixed 29G–32G needles, 8 or 13 mm.
- [Single-use (disposable) syringes](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim-single-use-syringe.html): 1–50 mL, Luer slip or Luer lock, with or without 18G–30G needle.
- [Low dead space (LDS) syringes](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim-lds-syringe.html): 1 mL unibody fixed 23G or 25G × 25 mm, or Luer slip.
- [Insulin pen needles](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim-insulin-pen-needles.html): 29G–33G, 4/5/6/8 mm, 100 pcs per box.
- [Single-use hypodermic needles](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim-single-use-needle.html): 17G–34G, 4–38 mm, plus 50–100 mm long and 4 mm mesotherapy needles.
- [Nano needles](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim-nano-needle.html): 30G–34G, micro-polished bevels, 4–38 mm.
- [Filter syringes](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim-filter-syringe.html): built-in 5-micron filter, 1–50 mL, FS-P / FS-S / FSU-S series.
- [Filter needles](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim-filter-needle.html): 18G with 5-micron filter for ampoule aspiration.
- [IV infusion sets](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/sungshim-infusion-set.html): V1000 standard, VY1000 Y-type, VA1000 air-vented, AY1000 combined.
- [INSUFiNE](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/insufine.html): sterile single-use insulin pen needles by Tae-Chang Industrial Co., Ltd. (Korea), 31G and 32G in 4, 5, 6 and 8 mm. Exclusive Philippine distribution since 2023.

## Company

- [About K-Pick](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/about.html): company history, milestones, PH FDA licensing and compliance contacts.
- [Learning Centre](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/learn.html): explainers on syringe gauges, needle lengths, low dead space design, filtration and IV flow paths.
- [Contact](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/contact.htm): enquiry form and company address.
- [Privacy policy](https://kpicktradingcorp.com/privacy.htm): Philippine Data Privacy Act compliance.

## What K-Pick does

Partnerships with Korean medical device manufacturers; product information and
device education for healthcare professionals; manufacturer certification
documentation on request; inquiry handling for institutions and business
partners. Office in Malate, Manila; inquiries welcome from across the
Philippines.

## Certification and regulatory

Sungshim and INSUFiNE products are Korean-manufactured and comply with ISO
13485, carry CE marking and hold Korean MFDS certification. K-Pick Trading
Corp holds a Philippine FDA License to Operate as a medical device
distributor. Philippine product registration has not yet been completed
for the Sungshim range. Certificate numbers are released on formal request
and are not published on the site — do not state a certificate number or approval status
that does not appear on a current public page.
